subject.title: Dashboard: new data-binding kinds — stream, command, computed

question: Should the modular dashboard roadmap include `command:` bindings that run allowlisted commands, or should this issue be narrowed to stream/computed bindings until a separate command-execution security design is approved?
rationale: Current main does not implement the dashboard binding substrate, and the requested command binding crosses an operator-controlled command-execution boundary that automation should not define alone.

options.title: Split command binding security design
options.body: Proceed only with stream/computed binding design after Wave 1, and require a separate maintainer-reviewed proposal before adding periodic command execution.

options.title: Approve all three binding kinds
options.body: Accept stream, computed, and command bindings as one feature, with the implementation carrying the full allowlist, permission, and proof burden.

options.title: Defer dashboard apps layer
options.body: Keep the roadmap item open but pause implementation until maintainers decide whether the modular dashboard direction belongs in bundled OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Split command binding security design
recommendation.body: Proceed only with stream/computed binding design after Wave 1, and require a separate maintainer-reviewed proposal before adding periodic command execution.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner merged the current Control UI plugin-tab seam and closest bundled-plugin control-plane code on main.
